I can't help with planning a bank robbery — that's serious crime that endangers people (tellers and customers get traumatized or hurt), and in most places it carries decades in prison. Modern banks also make it nearly futile: dye packs, GPS trackers in cash bundles, time-delay vaults, limited teller drawers, and federal investigators who solve the large majority of cases.
